<!-- ================= 0. WHAT IS A CONDITIONAL ================= -->
<section id="what" aria-labelledby="h-what">
  <h2 id="h-what"><span class="num">0</span>What is a conditional? 🧐</h2>
  <p class="lead">A <b class="kw">conditional sentence</b> <span class="zh">條件句</span> tells us: <b>if</b> one thing happens, <b>another thing</b> happens. It has <b class="kw">two parts</b>:</p>

  <div class="clauses" id="clauses" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="clause ifc" id="cIf"><span class="tag">if-clause <span class="zh">如果子句</span></span><span id="cIfText">If it rains</span><span class="comma-big" id="cComma" aria-label="comma">,</span></div>
    <div class="clause mainc" id="cMain"><span class="tag">main clause <span class="zh">主句</span></span><span id="cMainText">we will stay at home.</span></div>
  </div>
  <p id="swapMsg"><span class="comma-badge">“If” first ➜ use a comma ( , )</span></p>
  <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn" type="button" id="swapBtn" style="--bg:#d9480f" aria-pressed="false">🔄 Swap the order</button>
    <button class="say" type="button" id="swapSay" aria-label="Listen to the sentence" style="--c2:#d9480f">🔊</button>
    <button class="btn" type="button" id="trickBtn" style="--bg:#6a4cf0">🧠 Memory trick</button>
  </div>

  <ul class="facts" style="margin-top:14px">
    <li>✌️ <b class="kw">if-clause</b> = the condition. <b class="kw">main clause</b> = the result.</li>
    <li>✏️ <b class="kw">If</b> comes first ➜ put a <b class="kw">comma ( , )</b> after the if-clause. <span class="zh">逗號</span></li>
    <li>🔄 You can <b>swap the order</b>. Main clause first ➜ <b class="kw">no comma</b>.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3 style="margin:22px 0 0; font-size:1.2em">There are 4 types. Tap one! 👇</h3>
  <div class="types4">
    <a class="tcard t-zero" href="#zero"><span class="e" aria-hidden="true">🧊</span><b>Zero</b><span class="u">Always true</span></a>
    <a class="tcard t-first" href="#first"><span class="e" aria-hidden="true">🌧️</span><b>First</b><span class="u">Likely future</span></a>
    <a class="tcard t-second" href="#second"><span class="e" aria-hidden="true">💭</span><b>Second</b><span class="u">Imaginary now</span></a>
    <a class="tcard t-third" href="#third"><span class="e" aria-hidden="true">⏪</span><b>Third</b><span class="u">Past, can’t change</span></a>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 1. ZERO ================= -->
<section id="zero" aria-labelledby="h-zero">
  <h2 id="h-zero"><span class="num">1</span>Zero conditional 🧊</h2>
  <p class="lead">For things that are <b class="kw">always true</b>: <b>facts</b> and <b>general truths</b>. <span class="zh">事實、普遍真理</span></p>
  <div class="formula" role="img" aria-label="Formula: If plus present simple, present simple">
    <span class="f-if">If</span> + <span class="f-g"><span class="f-part">present simple</span><span class="f-comma">,</span></span> <span class="f-part">present simple</span>
    <span class="f-sub">heat / heats … , melt / melts …</span>
  </div>
  <div class="two">
    <ul class="facts">
      <li>✅ It happens <b>every time</b>. It is a <b>fact</b>.</li>
      <li>⏰ Use the <b class="kw">present simple</b> in <b>both</b> parts.</li>
      <li>🔁 Here, <b class="kw">if</b> means <b class="kw">when</b> / <b class="kw">every time</b>.<br><i>When you heat ice, it melts.</i></li>
    </ul>
    <div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">heat</b> ice, it <b class="kw">melts</b>.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">🧊</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> it <b class="kw">rains</b>, the ground <b class="kw">gets</b> wet.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">🌧️</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">don’t drink</b> water, you <b class="kw">feel</b> thirsty.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">🥤</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="note tip">💡 <b>Test:</b> Can you say <b class="kw">“every time”</b>? <i>Every time you heat ice, it melts.</i> ✅ Then it’s a <b>zero conditional</b>!</p>
<h3 class="memes-h">🤣 Remember it with memes &amp; photos!</h3>
<div class="memes">
<figure class="meme">
  <div class="meme-img"><img data-img="ice" alt="A melting ice cube on a wooden table"><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">HEAT + ICE =</span><span class="mt bottom" aria-hidden="true">IT MELTS. EVERY TIME.</span></div>
  <figcaption><span class="meme-tag in">📸 Real photo</span><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">heat</b> ice, it <b class="kw">melts</b>.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><p class="meme-note">✅ A fact: it happens <b>every time</b>.</p><p class="meme-src">📷 Real photo · “Melting” by Rebecca Partington · CC BY-SA 2.0 · <a href="#credits">Credits</a></p></figcaption>
</figure>

  <div class="meme-img"><img data-img="fish" alt="Salted fish drying on a round basket in Tai O, Hong Kong"><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">NO DREAMS?</span><span class="mt bottom" aria-hidden="true">同條鹹魚有咩分別呀？</span></div>
  <figcaption><span class="meme-tag in">🎬 HK meme</span><p class="meme-zh">「做人<b class="kw">如果</b>冇夢想，同條鹹魚有咩分別呀？」<span class="who">— 阿星（周星馳），《少林足球》2001</span></p><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">have</b> no dreams, you <b class="kw">are</b> just a salted fish! 🐟</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><p class="meme-note">💡 <b>如果</b> = <b class="kw">if</b>! A “salted fish” 鹹魚 = someone with no dreams who does nothing. (The photo shows real salted fish in Tai O, not the film.)</p><p class="meme-src">📷 Real photo (Tai O, HK) · 方畢可 · CC0 · <a href="#credits">Credits</a></p></figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 2. FIRST ================= -->
<section id="first" aria-labelledby="h-first">
  <h2 id="h-first"><span class="num">2</span>First conditional 🌧️</h2>
  <p class="lead">For a <b class="kw">real, possible future</b>. It <b>may really happen</b>! <span class="zh">將來可能發生的事</span></p>
  <div class="formula" role="img" aria-label="Formula: If plus present simple, will plus verb">
    <span class="f-if">If</span> + <span class="f-g"><span class="f-part">present simple</span><span class="f-comma">,</span></span> <span class="f-part">will + verb</span>
    <span class="f-sub">If it rains … , we will stay …</span>
  </div>
  <div class="two">
    <ul class="facts">
      <li>🔮 We are talking about the <b>future</b>, and it is <b>likely</b>.</li>
      <li>🚫 <b>No “will”</b> in the if-clause! Use the <b class="kw">present simple</b>.</li>
      <li>➕ Put <b class="kw">will + verb</b> in the main clause.</li>
      <li>📖 Some examples come from our <b>Unit 3</b> text! <span class="src">Unit 3</span></li>
    </ul>
    <div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> it <b class="kw">rains</b> tomorrow, we <b class="kw">will stay</b> at home.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">🏠</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">look</b> on our home page, you <b class="kw">will learn</b> more about our school rebuilding project. <span class="src">Unit 3</span></p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">help</b> us, we <b class="kw">will be</b> able to rebuild our school more quickly. <span class="src">Unit 3</span></p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> the dam <b class="kw">breaks</b>, we <b class="kw">will have</b> a severe flood. <span class="src">Unit 3</span></p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="note warn">⚠️ <b>Remember:</b> <s>If it <b>will rain</b> tomorrow…</s> ✗ &nbsp;➜&nbsp; <b class="kw">If it rains</b> tomorrow… ✓</p>
<h3 class="memes-h">🤣 Remember it with memes &amp; photos!</h3>
<div class="memes">
<figure class="meme">
  <div class="meme-img"><img data-img="typhoon" alt="Big waves at Heng Fa Chuen, Hong Kong, during Typhoon Ragasa (2025)"><span class="signal"><img data-img="t8" alt="Hong Kong No. 8 Northeast Gale or Storm Signal symbol"></span><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">IF THE T8 SIGNAL IS RAISED…</span><span class="mt bottom" aria-hidden="true">…SCHOOL WILL BE CLOSED!</span></div>
  <figcaption><span class="meme-tag in">📸 Real photo, HK</span><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> the T8 signal <b class="kw">is raised</b>, school <b class="kw">will be closed</b>.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><p class="meme-note">🌀 Real and possible in Hong Kong! <b>Stay at home and stay safe.</b> 🏠</p><p class="meme-src">📷 Real photo (HK, cropped) · TanoDano · CC BY 4.0 · <a href="#credits">Credits</a></p></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="meme">
  <div class="meme-img poster"><img data-img="shaolin" alt="Poster of the film Shaolin Soccer (2001) with Stephen Chow kicking a giant football"><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">PRACTISE EVERY DAY…</span><span class="mt bottom" aria-hidden="true">…SUPER FOOTBALLER!</span></div>
  <figcaption><span class="meme-tag in">🎬 Movie poster</span><p class="meme-zh">《少林足球》Shaolin Soccer (2001) ⚽</p><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> you <b class="kw">practise</b> kung fu every day, you <b class="kw">will become</b> a super footballer!</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><p class="meme-note">🥋 It’s possible — if you really practise!</p><p class="meme-src">📷 Movie poster · © the film’s producers/distributors · Fair use (education) · <a href="#credits">Credits</a></p></figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 3. SECOND ================= -->
<section id="second" aria-labelledby="h-second">
  <h2 id="h-second"><span class="num">3</span>Second conditional 💭</h2>
  <p class="lead">For <b class="kw">unreal, imaginary</b> things <b>now</b> or in the <b>future</b>. We are <b>dreaming</b>! <span class="zh">想像、不真實的事</span></p>
  <div class="formula" role="img" aria-label="Formula: If plus past simple, would plus verb">
    <span class="f-if">If</span> + <span class="f-g"><span class="f-part">past simple</span><span class="f-comma">,</span></span> <span class="f-part">would + verb</span>
    <span class="f-sub">If I had … , I would build …</span>
  </div>
  <div class="two">
    <ul class="facts">
      <li>🦄 It is <b>not true now</b>, or it is <b>very unlikely</b>.</li>
      <li>⏪ The verb looks <b class="kw">past</b>, but we are talking about <b>now</b>!</li>
      <li>➕ Put <b class="kw">would + verb</b> in the main clause.</li>
    </ul>
    <div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> I <b class="kw">had</b> a million dollars, I <b class="kw">would build</b> a new school.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">💰</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <button class="reveal-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🤔 What is real?</button>
      <p class="reveal-box" hidden>Real: I <b>don’t have</b> a million dollars. 😅</p>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> I <b class="kw">were</b> a bird, I <b class="kw">would fly</b> to Japan.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">🐦</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <button class="reveal-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🤔 What is real?</button>
      <p class="reveal-box" hidden>Real: I <b>am not</b> a bird. I can’t fly! 🙃</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="note">⭐ <b>Special rule:</b> <b class="kw">If I were…</b> We use <b class="kw">were</b> for <b>all persons</b>:<br>
  If I <b class="kw">were</b> · If you <b class="kw">were</b> · If he / she / it <b class="kw">were</b> · If we / they <b class="kw">were</b><br>
  <i>If I <b class="kw">were</b> you, I <b class="kw">would say</b> sorry.</i> 👍</p>
<h3 class="memes-h">🤣 Remember it with memes &amp; photos!</h3>
<div class="memes">

</div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 4. THIRD ================= -->
<section id="third" aria-labelledby="h-third">
  <h2 id="h-third"><span class="num">4</span>Third conditional ⏪</h2>
  <p class="lead">For the <b class="kw">unreal past</b>. It is <b>finished</b> and we <b>can’t change it</b>. Often a <b>regret</b>. 😢 <span class="zh">過去的遺憾</span></p>
  <div class="formula" role="img" aria-label="Formula: If plus had plus past participle, would have plus past participle">
    <span class="f-if">If</span> + <span class="f-g"><span class="f-part">had + past participle</span><span class="f-comma">,</span></span> <span class="f-part">would have + past participle</span>
    <span class="f-sub">If I had studied … , I would have passed …</span>
  </div>
  <div class="two">
    <ul class="facts">
      <li>🕰️ We imagine a <b>different past</b>. It <b>did not happen</b>.</li>
      <li>📚 <b>Past participle</b> <span class="zh">過去分詞</span>: study → <b class="kw">studied</b>, break → <b class="kw">broken</b>, go → <b class="kw">gone</b>, see → <b class="kw">seen</b></li>
      <li>✂️ Short forms: <b class="kw">I’d studied</b> = I had studied · <b class="kw">would’ve</b> = would have</li>
    </ul>
    <div>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> I <b class="kw">had studied</b> harder, I <b class="kw">would have passed</b> the test.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">📝</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <button class="reveal-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🤔 What really happened?</button>
      <p class="reveal-box" hidden>Real: I <b>didn’t study</b> hard. I <b>didn’t pass</b> the test. 😢</p>
      <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> the dam <b class="kw">had not broken</b>, the school <b class="kw">would not have flooded</b>.</p><span class="ex-e" aria-hidden="true">🌊</span><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
      <button class="reveal-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🤔 What really happened?</button>
      <p class="reveal-box" hidden>Real: The dam <b>broke</b>. The school <b>flooded</b>. 🏫🌊</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="note warn">⚠️ <b>No “would” in the if-clause!</b> <s>If I <b>would have</b> studied…</s> ✗ &nbsp;➜&nbsp; <b class="kw">If I had studied</b>… ✓</p>
<div class="star-meme" id="starMeme">
  <div class="star-left">
    <div class="star-poster"><img data-img="odyssey" alt="Poster of A Chinese Odyssey Part Two: Cinderella (1995) with Stephen Chow as the Monkey King"><span class="mt bottom" aria-hidden="true">後悔莫及…</span></div>
    <p class="meme-src">📷 Movie poster · © the film’s producers/distributors · Fair use (education) · <a href="#credits">Credits</a></p>
  </div>
  <div class="star-right">
    <span class="star-label">⭐ Star meme · 《大話西遊之仙履奇緣》(1995)</span>
    <div class="bubble" lang="zh-Hant">「曾經有一份真誠的愛情放在我面前，我沒有珍惜，等我失去的時候我才後悔莫及，人世間最痛苦的事莫過於此。」
      <span class="who">— 至尊寶（周星馳），《大話西遊之仙履奇緣》 A Chinese Odyssey Part Two: Cinderella</span></div>
    <p class="star-meaning">😢 He had something precious. He <b>didn’t treasure</b> it. He <b>lost</b> it. Now he <b>regrets</b> it — a perfect <b class="kw">third conditional</b>!</p>
    <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> I <b class="kw">had treasured</b> it, I <b class="kw">would not have lost</b> it.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
    <div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> I <b class="kw">had said</b> “I love you”, I <b class="kw">would not have regretted</b> it.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div>
    <button class="reveal-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🤔 What really happened?</button>
    <p class="reveal-box" hidden>Real: He <b>did not treasure</b> it, and he <b>lost</b> it. He <b>didn’t say</b> it in time. 😭</p>
    <p class="note" style="margin-top:12px">🎁 <b>Bonus:</b> his next line is a <b>second</b> conditional! 「<b class="kw">如果</b>上天能夠給我一個再來一次的機會，我會……」<br>
      👉 <b class="kw">If</b> Heaven <b class="kw">gave</b> me one more chance, I <b class="kw">would say</b> three words to her.</p>
    <p class="note tip">✏️ <b>Your turn!</b> Think of a chance you missed, or a time with a friend you wish was different.<br>
      <b class="kw">If I had</b> ____________, <b class="kw">I would have</b> ____________.<br>
      <i>e.g. If I had said sorry to my friend, we would have played together again.<br>If I had joined the football team, I would have made new friends.</i></p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="memes one">
<figure class="meme">
  <div class="meme-img"><img data-img="milk" alt="A glass of milk knocked over on a blue stool"><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">OOPS!</span><span class="mt bottom" aria-hidden="true">覆水難收</span></div>
  <figcaption><span class="meme-tag in">📸 Real photo</span><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t"><b class="kw">If</b> I <b class="kw">had been</b> more careful, I <b class="kw">would not have spilled</b> the milk.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><p class="meme-note">🥛 English saying: <i>“It’s no use crying over spilled milk.”</i> — a similar idea to 覆水難收: what’s done is done.</p><p class="meme-src">📷 Real photo · DEEPAN RAJA .M · CC BY-SA 4.0 · <a href="#credits">Credits</a></p></figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 7. MISTAKES ================= -->
<section id="mistakes" aria-labelledby="h-mistakes">
  <h2 id="h-mistakes"><span class="num">7</span>Common mistakes 🚫</h2>
  <p class="lead">Can you find the mistake? Think first, then tap <b>Fix it!</b> 🔧</p>
  <div class="mgrid">
    <div class="mcard">
      <h3>1️⃣ “will” after “if”</h3>
      <p class="wrong-s"><span class="mk">✗</span>If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.</p>
      <button class="btn fix-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🔧 Fix it!</button>
      <div class="fix" hidden>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span><b class="kw">If it rains</b> tomorrow, we will stay at home.</p>
        <p class="why">👉 No <b class="kw">will</b> in the if-clause. Use the <b class="kw">present simple</b>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mcard">
      <h3>2️⃣ “would” after “if”</h3>
      <p class="wrong-s"><span class="mk">✗</span>If I would have studied harder, I would have passed.</p>
      <button class="btn fix-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🔧 Fix it!</button>
      <div class="fix" hidden>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span><b class="kw">If I had studied</b> harder, I would have passed.</p>
        <p class="why">👉 No <b class="kw">would</b> in the if-clause. Third conditional: <b class="kw">If + had + past participle</b>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mcard">
      <h3>3️⃣ “was” or “were”?</h3>
      <p class="wrong-s"><span class="mk">✗</span>If I was a bird, I would fly to Japan.</p>
      <button class="btn fix-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🔧 Fix it!</button>
      <div class="fix" hidden>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span><b class="kw">If I were</b> a bird, I would fly to Japan.</p>
        <p class="why">👉 Second conditional: use <b class="kw">were</b> for <b>all persons</b> (I, he, she, it…). People sometimes say “was” when chatting, but <b class="kw">were</b> is the correct answer for school and tests.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mcard">
      <h3>4️⃣ The missing comma</h3>
      <p class="wrong-s"><span class="mk">✗</span>If you heat ice it melts.</p>
      <button class="btn fix-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🔧 Fix it!</button>
      <div class="fix" hidden>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span>If you heat ice<b class="kw" style="font-size:1.4em">,</b> it melts.</p>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span>Ice melts if you heat it. <span style="font-weight:700">(no comma)</span></p>
        <p class="why">👉 <b class="kw">If</b> first ➜ <b class="kw">comma</b>. <b>Main clause</b> first ➜ <b class="kw">no comma</b>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mcard">
      <h3>5️⃣ Mixing the pairs</h3>
      <p class="wrong-s"><span class="mk">✗</span>If I had a million dollars, I will build a new school.</p>
      <button class="btn fix-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🔧 Fix it!</button>
      <div class="fix" hidden>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span>If I <b class="kw">had</b> a million dollars, I <b class="kw">would build</b> a new school.</p>
        <p class="why">👉 Match the pair! <b class="kw">present → will</b> · <b class="kw">past → would</b> · <b class="kw">had + p.p. → would have + p.p.</b></p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mcard">
      <h3>6️⃣ Wrong past participle</h3>
      <p class="wrong-s"><span class="mk">✗</span>If the dam had not broke, the school would not have flooded.</p>
      <button class="btn fix-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false">🔧 Fix it!</button>
      <div class="fix" hidden>
        <p class="right-s"><span class="mk">✓</span>If the dam had not <b class="kw">broken</b>, the school would not have flooded.</p>
        <p class="why">👉 break – broke – <b class="kw">broken</b>. After <b class="kw">had</b>, use the <b class="kw">past participle</b>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="lab" data-ans='["rains", "will stay"]'>
  <div class="meme-img"><img data-img="typhoon" alt="Big waves at Heng Fa Chuen, Hong Kong, during Typhoon Ragasa (2025)"><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">BLACK RAIN? T8?</span><span class="meme-tag">Meme 4</span></div>
  <div class="lab-body">
    <p class="lab-q">If it <span class="gap"> ? </span> <i>(rain)</i> heavily tomorrow, we <span class="gap"> ? </span> <i>(stay)</i> at home.</p>
    <div class="opts" role="group" aria-label="Choose the verbs"><button class="opt" type="button" data-ok="1">rains … will stay</button><button class="opt" type="button" data-ok="0">will rain … stay</button><button class="opt" type="button" data-ok="0">rained … will stay</button></div>
    <p class="feedback" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <button class="reveal-btn lab-reveal" type="button">👀 Reveal answer</button>
    <div class="lab-answer" hidden><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t">If it rains heavily tomorrow, we will stay at home.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><span class="q-type" style="background:#1f6fd6">🌧️ First conditional</span></div>

  </div>
</div>
<div class="lab" data-ans='["came", "would ask"]'>
  <div class="meme-img"><img data-img="dorahk" alt="Doraemon 100 &amp; Friends display in Central MTR Station, Hong Kong (July 2024)"><span class="mt top" aria-hidden="true">DORAEMON IN HK?!</span><span class="meme-tag">Meme 5</span></div>
  <div class="lab-body">
    <p class="lab-q">If Doraemon <span class="gap"> ? </span> <i>(come)</i> to our school, I <span class="gap"> ? </span> <i>(ask)</i> him for a gadget.</p>
    <div class="opts" role="group" aria-label="Choose the verbs"><button class="opt" type="button" data-ok="1">came … would ask</button><button class="opt" type="button" data-ok="0">comes … would ask</button><button class="opt" type="button" data-ok="0">will come … would ask</button></div>
    <p class="feedback" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <button class="reveal-btn lab-reveal" type="button">👀 Reveal answer</button>
    <div class="lab-answer" hidden><div class="ex"><p class="ex-t">If Doraemon came to our school, I would ask him for a gadget.</p><button class="say" type="button" aria-label="Listen">🔊</button></div><span class="q-type" style="background:#6a4cf0">💭 Second conditional</span></div>

  <div class="lab-body">

<!-- ================= 10. SUMMARY ================= -->
<section id="summary" aria-labelledby="h-summary">
  <h2 id="h-summary"><span class="num">10</span>Summary 📋</h2>
  <p class="lead">All 4 types on one page. Print it and stick it in your book! 🖨️</p>
  <table class="sum-table">
    <caption class="sr">Summary of the four conditional types</caption>
    <thead><tr><th scope="col">Type</th><th scope="col">Formula</th><th scope="col">Use</th><th scope="col">Example</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr class="r-zero"><td data-label="Type">🧊 Zero</td><td data-label="Formula" class="fm">If + present simple, present simple</td><td data-label="Use">Always true: facts <span class="zh">事實</span></td><td data-label="Example">If you <b class="kw">heat</b> ice, it <b class="kw">melts</b>.</td></tr>
      <tr class="r-first"><td data-label="Type">🌧️ First</td><td data-label="Formula" class="fm">If + present simple, will + verb</td><td data-label="Use">Real, possible future <span class="zh">可能發生</span></td><td data-label="Example">If it <b class="kw">rains</b> tomorrow, we <b class="kw">will stay</b> at home.</td></tr>
      <tr class="r-second"><td data-label="Type">💭 Second</td><td data-label="Formula" class="fm">If + past simple, would + verb</td><td data-label="Use">Unreal, imaginary now / future <span class="zh">想像</span></td><td data-label="Example">If I <b class="kw">had</b> a million dollars, I <b class="kw">would build</b> a new school.</td></tr>
      <tr class="r-third"><td data-label="Type">⏪ Third</td><td data-label="Formula" class="fm">If + had + past participle, would have + past participle</td><td data-label="Use">Unreal past, regrets <span class="zh">過去的遺憾</span></td><td data-label="Example">If I <b class="kw">had studied</b> harder, I <b class="kw">would have passed</b> the test.</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="note tip">✏️ <b>Remember:</b> <b class="kw">If</b> first ➜ <b class="kw">comma</b>. No <b class="kw">will</b> / <b class="kw">would</b> in the if-clause. <b class="kw">If I were…</b> for all persons.</p>
  <div class="btn-row"><button class="btn" type="button" id="printBtn" style="--bg:#1f2a44">🖨️ Print the summary</button></div>
</section>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  /* ---------- v2: embedded images (work offline) ---------- */
  var IMGS = {
    "ice": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "icecream": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "fish": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "typhoon": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "t8": "data:image/png;base64,",
    "shaolin": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "cookery": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "door": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "dorahk": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "chow": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "odyssey": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "milk": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "bus": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
  };
  var imgEls = document.querySelectorAll("img[data-img]");
  for (var ii = 0; ii < imgEls.length; ii++) {
    var key = imgEls[ii].getAttribute("data-img");
    if (IMGS[key]) imgEls[ii].src = IMGS[key];
  }

  function shuffle(a) {
    a = a.slice();
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t; }
    return a;
  }
  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  /* ---------- Type info ---------- */
  var TYPES = {
    zero:   { name: "Zero conditional",   short: "Zero",   emoji: "🧊", color: "#0b8a87", tint: "#e9fbfa",
              ifF: "present simple", mainF: "present simple", use: "always true (facts)" },
    first:  { name: "First conditional",  short: "First",  emoji: "🌧️", color: "#1f6fd6", tint: "#eef6ff",
              ifF: "present simple", mainF: "will + verb", use: "a real, possible future" },
    second: { name: "Second conditional", short: "Second", emoji: "💭", color: "#6a4cf0", tint: "#f3f0ff",
              ifF: "past simple", mainF: "would + verb", use: "something imaginary now or in the future" },
    third:  { name: "Third conditional",  short: "Third",  emoji: "⏪", color: "#d6336c", tint: "#fff1f6",
              ifF: "had + past participle", mainF: "would have + past participle", use: "the unreal past (it can't change)" }
  };
  var ORDER = ["zero", "first", "second", "third"];
  function formulaText(t) { return "If + " + TYPES[t].ifF + ", " + TYPES[t].mainF; }
  function fillFormula(box, t) {
    box.textContent = "";
    box.setAttribute("role", "img");
    box.setAttribute("aria-label", "Formula: " + formulaText(t).replace(/\+/g, "plus"));
    box.appendChild(el("span", "f-if", "If"));
    box.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" + "));
    var g = el("span", "f-g");
    g.appendChild(el("span", "f-part", TYPES[t].ifF));
    g.appendChild(el("span", "f-comma", ","));
    box.appendChild(g);
    box.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));
    box.appendChild(el("span", "f-part", TYPES[t].mainF));
  }

  /* ---------- Speech (en-GB) ---------- */
  var synth = window.speechSynthesis || null, voice = null, speakingBtn = null;
  function pickVoice() {
    if (!synth) return;
    var vs = synth.getVoices() || [], i;
    voice = null;
    for (i = 0; i < vs.length; i++) if (/en[-_]GB/i.test(vs[i].lang)) { voice = vs[i]; break; }
    if (!voice) for (i = 0; i < vs.length; i++) if (/^en/i.test(vs[i].lang)) { voice = vs[i]; break; }
  }
  if (synth && typeof window.SpeechSynthesisUtterance === "function") {
    pickVoice();
    if ("onvoiceschanged" in synth) synth.onvoiceschanged = pickVoice;
  } else {
    synth = null;
    document.documentElement.classList.add("no-speech");
  }
  function cleanText(s) {
    return s.replace(/Unit 3/g, "").replace(/[\u2190-\u21FF\u2300-\u27BF\u2B00-\u2BFF\uFE0F\u200D]|\uD83C[\uDC00-\uDFFF]|\uD83D[\uDC00-\uDFFF]|\uD83E[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }
  function say(text, btn) {
    if (!synth) return;
    try {
      synth.cancel();
      if (speakingBtn) speakingBtn.classList.remove("speaking");
      var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanText(text));
      u.lang = "en-GB"; u.rate = 0.85;
      if (voice) u.voice = voice;
      if (btn) {
        speakingBtn = btn; btn.classList.add("speaking");
        u.onend = u.onerror = function () { btn.classList.remove("speaking"); };
      }
      synth.speak(u);
    } catch (e) { /* speech not available */ }
  }
  var exBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".ex .say");
  for (var sb = 0; sb < exBtns.length; sb++) {
    exBtns[sb].addEventListener("click", function () {
      var t = this.parentNode.querySelector(".ex-t");
      say(t ? t.textContent : "", this);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Reveal buttons ("What is real?") ---------- */
  var reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal-btn:not(.lab-reveal)");
  for (var rv = 0; rv < reveals.length; rv++) {
    reveals[rv].addEventListener("click", function () {

  /* ---------- 0. Swap the order ---------- */
  var swapped = false;
  function renderSwap() {
    var clauses = $("clauses"), cIf = $("cIf"), cMain = $("cMain");
    if (!swapped) {
      $("cIfText").textContent = "If it rains";
      $("cComma").hidden = false;
      $("cMainText").textContent = "we will stay at home.";
      clauses.insertBefore(cIf, cMain);
      $("swapMsg").innerHTML = '<span class="comma-badge">“If” first ➜ use a comma ( , )</span>';
    } else {
      $("cIfText").textContent = "if it rains.";
      $("cComma").hidden = true;
      $("cMainText").textContent = "We will stay at home";
      clauses.insertBefore(cMain, cIf);
      $("swapMsg").innerHTML = '<span class="comma-badge no">Main clause first ➜ NO comma</span>';
    }
    $("swapBtn").setAttribute("aria-pressed", swapped ? "true" : "false");
  }
  $("swapBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { swapped = !swapped; renderSwap(); });
  $("swapSay").addEventListener("click", function () {
    say(swapped ? "We will stay at home if it rains." : "If it rains, we will stay at home.", this);
  });

  /* ---------- Modal ---------- */
  var modal = $("modal"), lastTrigger = null;
  function openModal(o) {
    lastTrigger = o.trigger || document.activeElement;
    $("mEmoji").textContent = o.emoji || "";
    $("mTitle").textContent = o.title || "";
    var body = $("mBody");
    body.innerHTML = o.html || "";
    body.className = o.center ? "center" : "";
    $("modalCard").style.setProperty("--mc", o.color || "#ff8a1f");
    var btns = $("mBtns");
    var extra = btns.querySelectorAll(".extra");
    for (var i = 0; i < extra.length; i++) btns.removeChild(extra[i]);
    if (o.extraBtn) {
      var b = el("button", "btn extra", o.extraBtn.label);
      b.type = "button"; b.style.setProperty("--bg", o.extraBtn.color || "#d6336c");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { closeModal(true); o.extraBtn.action(); });
      btns.insertBefore(b, btns.firstChild);
    }
    modal.hidden = false;
    $("mOk").focus();
  }
  function closeModal(noRefocus) {
    if (modal.hidden) return;
    modal.hidden = true;
    if (!noRefocus && lastTrigger && lastTrigger.focus && document.body.contains(lastTrigger)) lastTrigger.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  $("mClose").addEventListener("click", function () { closeModal(); });
  $("mOk").addEventListener("click", function () { closeModal(); });
  modal.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === modal) closeModal(); });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (modal.hidden) return;
    if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "Esc") { closeModal(); return; }
    if (e.key === "Tab") {
      var f = $("modalCard").querySelectorAll("button");
      var first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
      else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
    }
  });
  $("trickBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    openModal({
      emoji: "🧠", title: "Memory trick: step back in time!", color: "#6a4cf0", trigger: this,
      html: '<p style="margin-top:0">Each type goes <b class="kw">one step back</b> in time and gets <b>less real</b>:</p>' +
        '<ul class="ladder">' +
        '<li style="background:#0b8a87">🧊 Zero: <b>present</b> + <b>present</b> (always true)</li>' +
        '<li style="background:#1f6fd6">🌧️ First: <b>present</b> + <b>will</b> (likely)</li>' +
        '<li style="background:#6a4cf0">💭 Second: <b>past</b> + <b>would</b> (imaginary)</li>' +
        '<li style="background:#d6336c">⏪ Third: <b>had + p.p.</b> + <b>would have + p.p.</b> (past, can’t change)</li>' +
        '</ul><p style="margin-bottom:0">🚫 <b>Never</b> put <b class="kw">will</b> or <b class="kw">would</b> after <b class="kw">if</b>!</p>'
    });
  });

  /* ---------- 5. How real is it? ---------- */
  var REAL = [

    { t: "second", emoji: "💭", level: "Imaginary now", ex: "If I had a million dollars, I would build a new school.",
      mean: "It’s not true now. We are dreaming! (I don’t have a million dollars.) 😅" },
    { t: "third", emoji: "⏪", level: "Past, can’t change", ex: "If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.",

    for (var k = 0; k < lvlBtns.length; k++) lvlBtns[k].setAttribute("aria-pressed", k === i ? "true" : "false");
    if (flash && !reduceMotion) { realCard.classList.remove("flash"); void realCard.offsetWidth; realCard.classList.add("flash"); }

  }
  $("rSay").addEventListener("click", function () { say($("rEx").textContent, this); });
  updateReal(false);

  /* ---------- 6. Sentence builder ----------
     i = correct if-clause, m = correct main clause,
     bi / bm = wrong chunks (wrong tense for this type). */
  var BUILD = {
    zero: [
      { i: "If you heat ice,", m: "it melts.", bi: "If you will heat ice,", bm: "it would melt." },

      { i: "If you mix red and yellow,", m: "you get orange.", bi: "If you will mix red and yellow,", bm: "you would get orange." },
      { i: "If you drop an egg,", m: "it breaks.", bi: "If you had dropped an egg,", bm: "it would break." },
      { i: "If water reaches 100°C,", m: "it boils.", bi: "If water will reach 100°C,", bm: "it would have boiled." }

      { i: "If it rains tomorrow,", m: "we will stay at home.", bi: "If it will rain tomorrow,", bm: "we would stay at home." },

      { i: "If you study hard,", m: "you will pass the test.", bi: "If you will study hard,", bm: "you would have passed the test." },

    ],
    second: [

      { i: "If I were you,", m: "I would say sorry.", bi: "If I would be you,", bm: "I will say sorry." },

    ],

      { i: "If I had studied harder,", m: "I would have passed the test.", bi: "If I study harder,", bm: "I will pass the test." },
      { i: "If the dam had not broken,", m: "the school would not have flooded.", bi: "If the dam would not have broken,", bm: "the school will not flood." },
      { i: "If we had left earlier,", m: "we would have caught the bus.", bi: "If we leave earlier,", bm: "we will catch the bus." },
      { i: "If it had not rained,", m: "we would have played football.", bi: "If it will not rain,", bm: "we will play football." },
      { i: "If you had told me,", m: "I would have helped you.", bi: "If you would have told me,", bm: "I will help you." },
      { i: "If she had woken up on time,", m: "she would not have been late.", bi: "If she wakes up on time,", bm: "she will not be late." }
    ]
  };
  var bType = "zero", bIdx = -1, bPlaced = [], bChunks = [], bDone = {}, bSolved = false;
  var pool = $("pool"), answerLine = $("answerLine"), bFb = $("bFeedback");
  var typeBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".type-pick .btn");
  function newSentence() {
    var list = BUILD[bType], n;
    do { n = Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length); } while (list.length > 1 && n === bIdx);
    bIdx = n;
    var s = list[n];
    bChunks = shuffle([
      { t: s.i, role: "if", ok: true }, { t: s.m, role: "main", ok: true },
      { t: s.bi, role: "if", ok: false }, { t: s.bm, role: "main", ok: false }
    ]);
    for (var k = 0; k < bChunks.length; k++) bChunks[k].id = k;
    bPlaced = []; bSolved = false;
    setFb("", "");
    renderBuilder();
  }
  function setFb(msg, cls) { bFb.textContent = msg; bFb.className = cls; }
  function renderBuilder() {
    pool.textContent = ""; answerLine.textContent = "";
    answerLine.classList.remove("good", "bad");
    bChunks.forEach(function (c) {
      var b = el("button", "chunk " + c.role, c.t);
      b.type = "button";
      var used = bPlaced.indexOf(c.id) > -1;
      if (used) { b.classList.add("used"); b.disabled = true; b.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); b.tabIndex = -1; }
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Add: " + c.t);
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { placeChunk(c.id); });
      pool.appendChild(b);
    });
    if (!bPlaced.length) answerLine.appendChild(el("span", "empty", "👆 Tap two chunks below…"));
    bPlaced.forEach(function (id, pos) {
      var c = bChunks[id];
      var txt = c.t;
      if (pos === 0) txt = txt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + txt.slice(1);
      var b = el("button", "chunk " + c.role, txt);
      b.type = "button";
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Take out: " + c.t);
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { removeChunk(id); });
      answerLine.appendChild(b);
    });
    var done = 0; for (var k in bDone) if (bDone.hasOwnProperty(k)) done++;
    $("bCount").textContent = done ? "⭐ Sentences built correctly: " + done : "";
  }
  function placeChunk(id) {
    if (bSolved) return;
    if (bPlaced.length >= 2) { setFb("✋ Only two chunks! Tap a chunk in your sentence to take it out.", "bad"); return; }
    bPlaced.push(id); setFb("", ""); renderBuilder();
    if (bPlaced.length === 2) $("bCheck").focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  function removeChunk(id) {
    if (bSolved) return;
    bPlaced.splice(bPlaced.indexOf(id), 1); setFb("", ""); renderBuilder();
  }
  function builtSentence() {
    return bPlaced.map(function (id, pos) {
      var t = bChunks[id].t;
      return pos === 0 ? t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1) : t;
    }).join(" ");
  }
  function checkBuilder() {
    if (bSolved) return;
    var T = TYPES[bType];
    if (bPlaced.length < 2) { setFb("👉 Tap one if-clause and one main clause first.", "bad"); return; }
    var a = bChunks[bPlaced[0]], b = bChunks[bPlaced[1]];
    var msg = "";
    if (a.role !== "if" || b.role !== "main") {
      if (a.role === b.role) msg = "❌ You need one if-clause AND one main clause.";
      else msg = "❌ Start with the if-clause this time (the part with “If” and the comma).";
    } else if (!a.ok && !b.ok) {
      msg = "❌ That is not a " + T.short.toLowerCase() + " conditional. Look at the formula: " + formulaText(bType) + ".";
    } else if (!a.ok) {
      msg = "❌ Check the if-clause! " + T.short + " conditional: If + " + T.ifF + ".";
    } else if (!b.ok) {
      msg = "❌ Check the main clause! " + T.short + " conditional: … , " + T.mainF + ".";
    }
    answerLine.classList.remove("good", "bad");
    void answerLine.offsetWidth;
    if (msg) { answerLine.classList.add("bad"); setFb(msg, "bad"); return; }
    bSolved = true;
    bDone[bType + bIdx] = true;
    answerLine.classList.add("good");
    setFb("✅ Correct! Great " + T.short.toLowerCase() + " conditional! 🎉 Press Shuffle for a new one.", "good");
    var done = 0; for (var k in bDone) if (bDone.hasOwnProperty(k)) done++;
    $("bCount").textContent = "⭐ Sentences built correctly: " + done;
    say(builtSentence(), $("bSay"));
  }
  function setType(t) {
    bType = t; bIdx = -1;
    for (var k = 0; k < typeBtns.length; k++) typeBtns[k].setAttribute("aria-pressed", typeBtns[k].getAttribute("data-type") === t ? "true" : "false");
    var f = $("bFormula");
    fillFormula(f, t);
    f.style.borderColor = TYPES[t].color; f.style.background = TYPES[t].tint;
    newSentence();
  }
  for (var tb = 0; tb < typeBtns.length; tb++) {
    typeBtns[tb].addEventListener("click", function () { setType(this.getAttribute("data-type")); });
  }
  $("bCheck").addEventListener("click", checkBuilder);
  $("bClear").addEventListener("click", function () { bPlaced = []; bSolved = false; setFb("", ""); renderBuilder(); });
  $("bShuffle").addEventListener("click", newSentence);
  $("bSay").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (bPlaced.length) say(builtSentence(), this);
    else setFb("👉 Build a sentence first, then press 🔊.", "bad");
  });
  setType("zero");

  for (var fb = 0; fb < fixBtns.length; fb++) {

  /* ---------- 8. Meme Lab (v2) ---------- */
  var labs = document.querySelectorAll(".lab"), labSolved = 0, labResets = [];
  function labScore() {
    $("labScore").textContent = "🤣 Memes made: " + labSolved + " / " + labs.length + (labSolved === labs.length ? "  🏆 Meme master!" : "");
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(labs, function (lab) {
    var optBox = lab.querySelector(".opts"), btns = Array.prototype.slice.call(optBox.querySelectorAll(".opt"));
    var fb = lab.querySelector(".feedback"), gaps = lab.querySelectorAll(".gap"), ans = JSON.parse(lab.getAttribute("data-ans"));
    var rev = lab.querySelector(".lab-reveal"), box = lab.querySelector(".lab-answer"), done = false;
    function order() { shuffle(btns).forEach(function (b) { optBox.appendChild(b); }); }
    function fill() {
      for (var g = 0; g < gaps.length; g++) gaps[g].textContent = ans[g];
      box.hidden = false; rev.hidden = true;
      btns.forEach(function (x) { x.disabled = true; if (x.getAttribute("data-ok") === "1") x.classList.add("right"); });
    }
    btns.forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (done) return;
        if (b.getAttribute("data-ok") === "1") {
          done = true; fill();
          fb.className = "feedback good"; fb.textContent = "✅ Brilliant! You made the meme! 🎉";
          lab.classList.add("solved"); labSolved++; labScore();
        } else {
          b.classList.add("wrong"); b.disabled = true;
          fb.className = "feedback bad"; fb.textContent = "❌ Not this one. Check the formula and try again!";
        }
      });
    });
    rev.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (done) return;
      done = true; fill();
      fb.className = "feedback"; fb.textContent = "👀 Here’s the answer. Read it aloud!";
    });
    labResets.push(function () {
      done = false; lab.classList.remove("solved"); box.hidden = true; rev.hidden = false;
      fb.className = "feedback"; fb.textContent = "";
      for (var g = 0; g < gaps.length; g++) gaps[g].textContent = "\u00a0?\u00a0";
      btns.forEach(function (x) { x.disabled = false; x.classList.remove("right", "wrong"); });
      order();
    });
    order();
  });
  $("labReset").addEventListener("click", function () { labSolved = 0; labResets.forEach(function (f) { f(); }); labScore(); });
  labScore();

  var BANK_B = [
    { t: "zero", s: "If you freeze water, it turns into ice." },

    { t: "first", s: "If we finish early, we will play a game." },

  function Quiz(root, bank, mode) {
    var body = root.querySelector(".q-body");
    var items, idx, score, answered;
    function start() {
      items = shuffle(bank).map(function (it) {
        var opts = mode === "A" ? shuffle([it.a].concat(it.o)) : ORDER.slice();
        return { it: it, opts: opts };
      });
      idx = 0; score = 0; answered = false;
      render(false);
    }
    function typeTag(t) {
      var s = el("span", "q-type", TYPES[t].emoji + " " + TYPES[t].short);
      s.style.background = TYPES[t].color;
      return s;
    }
    function fullSentence(it) { return it.q.replace("___", it.a); }
    function render(focus) {
      body.textContent = "";
      var N = items.length, cur = items[idx], it = cur.it;
      var top = el("div", "q-top");
      top.appendChild(el("span", null, "Question " + (idx + 1) + " / " + N));
      var sc = el("span", "q-score", "Score: " + score);
      top.appendChild(sc);
      body.appendChild(top);
      var prog = el("div", "q-prog"), bar = el("div");
      bar.style.width = (idx / N * 100) + "%";
      prog.appendChild(bar); body.appendChild(prog);
      var qt = el("p", "q-text");
      qt.tabIndex = -1;
      var gapSpan = null;
      if (mode === "A") {
        var parts = it.q.split("___");
        qt.appendChild(document.createTextNode(parts[0]));
        gapSpan = el("span", "gap", "\u00a0?\u00a0");
        gapSpan.setAttribute("aria-label", "blank");
        qt.appendChild(gapSpan);
        qt.appendChild(document.createTextNode(parts[1]));
      } else {
        qt.appendChild(document.createTextNode("“" + it.s + "”"));
      }
      body.appendChild(qt);
      var opts = el("div", "opts");
      opts.setAttribute("role", "group");
      opts.setAttribute("aria-label", "Answers");
      var fbk = el("p", "feedback");
      fbk.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
      var nextRow = el("div", "btn-row");
      var next = el("button", "btn", idx + 1 < N ? "Next ➜" : "See my score 🏆");
      next.type = "button"; next.style.setProperty("--bg", "#9c36b5"); next.hidden = true;
      next.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (idx + 1 < N) { idx++; render(true); } else finish();
      });
      var buttons = [];
      cur.opts.forEach(function (o) {
        var label = mode === "A" ? o : TYPES[o].emoji + " " + TYPES[o].short;
        var b = el("button", "opt", label);
        b.type = "button";
        b.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (answered) return;
          answered = true;
          var correct = mode === "A" ? it.a : it.t;
          var ok = o === correct;
          buttons.forEach(function (x) {
            x.btn.disabled = true;
            if (x.val === correct) x.btn.classList.add("right");
          });
          if (!ok) b.classList.add("wrong");
          if (ok) score++;
          sc.textContent = "Score: " + score;
          bar.style.width = ((idx + 1) / N * 100) + "%";
          var T = TYPES[it.t];
          fbk.className = "feedback " + (ok ? "good" : "bad");
          fbk.textContent = "";
          if (mode === "A") {
            gapSpan.textContent = it.a;
            gapSpan.removeAttribute("aria-label");
            fbk.appendChild(document.createTextNode(ok ? "✅ Correct! " : "❌ Not quite. The answer is “" + it.a + "”. "));
            fbk.appendChild(typeTag(it.t));
            fbk.appendChild(el("span", "f2", T.name + ": " + formulaText(it.t) + "."));
          } else {
            fbk.appendChild(document.createTextNode(ok ? "✅ Yes! It's the " + T.name.toLowerCase() + ". " : "❌ No, it's the " + T.name.toLowerCase() + ". "));
            fbk.appendChild(el("span", "f2", formulaText(it.t) + " → " + T.use + "."));
          }
          answered = true;
          next.hidden = false;
          next.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        });
        buttons.push({ btn: b, val: o });
        opts.appendChild(b);
      });
      body.appendChild(opts);
      body.appendChild(fbk);
      nextRow.appendChild(next);
      body.appendChild(nextRow);
      answered = false;
      if (focus) qt.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    function verdict(p) {
      return p === 1 ? ["🏆", "Perfect! Conditional champion!"] :
             p >= 0.8 ? ["🌟", "Excellent work!"] :
             p >= 0.6 ? ["👍", "Good job! Keep practising."] :
                        ["💪", "Nice try! Read the formulas and try again."];
    }
    function finish() {
      var N = items.length, p = score / N, v = verdict(p);
      var stars = p === 1 ? "⭐⭐⭐" : p >= 0.6 ? "⭐⭐" : "⭐";
      body.textContent = "";
      var res = el("div", "q-result");
      res.appendChild(el("div", "stars", stars));
      res.appendChild(el("div", "big", score + " / " + N));
      res.appendChild(el("p", null, v[0] + " " + v[1]));
      var row = el("div", "btn-row"), again = el("button", "btn", "🔄 Try again");
      again.type = "button"; again.style.setProperty("--bg", "#9c36b5");
      again.addEventListener("click", function () { start(); root.querySelector(".q-text").focus({ preventScroll: true }); });
      row.appendChild(again); res.appendChild(row);
      body.appendChild(res);
      openModal({
        emoji: v[0], title: (mode === "A" ? "Part A" : "Part B") + " score: " + score + " / " + N, color: "#9c36b5", center: true,
        html: '<p class="stars" style="margin:0">' + stars + '</p><p>' + v[1] + '</p>',
        trigger: again,
        extraBtn: { label: "🔄 Try again", color: "#9c36b5", action: function () { start(); root.querySelector(".q-text").focus({ preventScroll: true }); } }
      });
    }
    start();
    return { start: start };
  }
  Quiz($("quizA"), BANK_A, "A");
  Quiz($("quizB"), BANK_B, "B");

  /* ---------- 9. Print summary ---------- */
  $("printBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    document.body.classList.add("print-summary");
    window.print();
    setTimeout(function () { document.body.classList.remove("print-summary"); }, 500);
  });
  window.addEventListener("afterprint", function () { document.body.classList.remove("print-summary"); });

  /* expose a tiny hook for automated checks */
  window.__cond = { BUILD: BUILD, BANK_A: BANK_A, BANK_B: BANK_B };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
